serverDayNote: Server day counts from this account's creation (the stored server epoch); the debug clock can fast-forward it.

modes.name: Hoopa's Vault
modes.tagline: Outrun the shadow and choose your route.
modes.description: An escape-chase run through a shifting vault. Pick routes, bank escape progress and face the exit guardian for held items and Resetter Shards.
features: Route choices, buffs and an exit guardian
Held items, Resetter Shards and free daily keys

modes.name: Rift Arena
modes.tagline: Break the barrier, then read the ring.
modes.description: A two-part rift: clear barriers and trade with the Mystic Merchant, then survive ring battles and answer the quiz rounds.

modes.name: Sky Pillar
modes.tagline: Climb until the clouds give way.
modes.description: A long vertical climb of staged fights. Each cleared floor improves the daily haul, and the pillar resets its attempts every day.

modes.name: Faction Tower
modes.description: A faction-locked tower with its own floor ladder and weekly reset. Each faction answers a different enemy pool and boss cadence.

modes.name: Misty Woods
modes.tagline: Follow the rune-light through the fog.
modes.description: A fogbound rune hunt with a revival crystal, a redeem shop and a 244-node rune map. Each node asks for a different squad answer.

modes.name: Pet Home
modes.tagline: Summon, open and merge your Wilds at home.
modes.description: A growing 5x5 merge board. Summon balls, open them into Wilds, merge equal levels, and let the Home earn coins for its two shops.
features: 17 Home levels and a 6-to-21 tile board
Summon, open, merge and release Wilds
Home Coins, level rewards and two shops

modes.name: Island Challenge
modes.tagline: Ninety levels, then the alliance contest.
modes.description: A 90-level island circuit that ends in a full simulated 5v5 alliance contest with bot alliances, orders, support and settlement.

modes.name: Ultra Wormhole
modes.tagline: Hire across the breach before the window closes.
modes.description: A weekly wormhole window with 135 hires, score thresholds, a hero bag and an album. Hire the right answers before the wormhole seals.
